newsitem.title: LATVIA: OTC SHARE TRADE FALLS IN WEEK OF APRIL 21-25.
newsitem.headline: OTC SHARE TRADE FALLS IN WEEK OF APRIL 21-25.

text.p: Trade on the over-the-counter market fell to 114,939 lats in the week of April 21 to April 25 compared with 443,512 lats the previous week, the stock exchange said on Tuesday.
The OTC trade was also below trade on the official market that week, which came to 424,268 lats.
The most traded share on the OTC market in April 21 to 25 was Riga Transport Fleet at 86,202 lats followed by Unibanka on 11,266 lats.
